purpose: Sends an instant internal alert to the client's staff when a new lead is captured, via email, an approved WhatsApp template, Telegram or Slack.

configurationFields.description: live only after Gate 2 and operator activation

permissionsRequired: Send email from the configured mailbox
Send WhatsApp template messages to staff numbers

testCases.expectedOutcome: Message rendered and logged; nothing sent externally

testCases.description: Staging mode with a test recipient
testCases.expectedOutcome: Exactly one message delivered to the test recipient
Failure logged; email fallback attempted; workflow does not crash

knownLimitations: Contract only: n8n blueprint JSON not yet built and exported (Phase B).
WhatsApp requires a client-owned Meta Business account and approved template; per-message fees apply.
rollbackApproach: Set mode=dry-run or deactivate the workflow in n8n; alerts remain visible in the lead dashboard.
